description: Attack, hold and decay envelope generator with exponential transitions, the envelope that makes the snappy sounds of the Trummor drums, with a stereo VCA the envelope controls

params.text: Sets the rising rate of the envelope
Sets the time the envelope stays at its maximum of 10V
Sets the rate at which the envelope returns to 0V
Attenuates and inverts the ATTACK input before it is added to the ATTACK knob
Attenuates and inverts the HOLD input before it is added to the HOLD knob
Attenuates and inverts the DECAY input before it is added to the DECAY knob
Picks the envelope: SOFT for longer transitions, HARD for faster transitions and a snappier envelope, LOOP for repeats that suit snare sounds, where ATTACK sets the rise and fall of each repetition

inputs.text: A signal above 2V triggers the envelope
A control voltage added to the ATTACK setting, scaled by the ATTACK attenuverter
A control voltage added to the HOLD setting, scaled by the HOLD attenuverter
A control voltage added to the DECAY setting, scaled by the DECAY attenuverter
The left channel of the audio input to the VCA
The right channel of the audio input to the VCA

outputs.text: The left channel of the VCA, the input multiplied by the envelope
The right channel of the VCA, the input multiplied by the envelope

notes: in LOOP mode HOLD sets how long the repeats last and DECAY the final fall
